acceptance: With a live wave fixture and one held slot, a second full-suite request is refused with the holder named, through the real entry point.
With no live wave the request runs.
The refusal text names the rule and the wave pid.
fix: Design review first: the home of the guard is open, because a console agent runs go test in its own shell, not through evolve. Design review first. A console verb that starts a full suite takes a console suite slot while a wave runs (loop pid alive). A second request is refused with the holder named. The review agents start their suites through the same verb or the same slot.
summary: During wave 185 the console ran three review agents in parallel. Each ran a full race suite and one reported a host load of 70 to 120. The standing rule is at most one console full suite during a wave. It is a memory note, so no agent knew it.
title: A second console full test suite during a live wave is refused with the reason
